run_dlrm_data_preprocessing: run the Criteo dataset preprocessing CLI with --raw-data-file and --data-set kaggle or terabyte
getCriteoAdData: call getCriteoAdData to download and preprocess Criteo Kaggle or Terabyte click logs into .npz files
loadDataset: call loadDataset to load and preprocess kaggle or terabyte datasets with optional memory mapping
transformCriteoAdData: call transformCriteoAdData to apply log transformation on dense features and split into train val test sets
convertUStringToDistinctIntsDict: call convertUStringToDistinctIntsDict to convert a matrix of unicode strings into distinct integer IDs per column
